$doc: Game modes and challenge modifiers. A mode can override the wave set (waves), generate waves (endless), change tuning knobs (tune: multipliers like data/tuning.json), and set flags: infiniteCash, allTowers (loadout may use any tower), noRewards, maxDuration/intermission (seconds), maxWaves (stop after wave n), keepHpFixed (keep health, ignores difficulty), mutations (one seeded per wave from mutationsFrom: speed / hp / count multipliers, armor add; bosses only take speed and armour), rewardMul, score ('waves' | 'time'). Modifiers stack; each multiplies the crowns reward by rewardMul. The Daily Challenge picks seeded modifiers whose dailyCost (difficulty points) fits its dailyBudget (inDaily: false keeps one out of the daily).

modes.name: Endless
modes.desc: Waves never stop. A boss every 10. How far can you go?

modes.name: Boss Rush
modes.desc: Every boss in the game, back to back, growing stronger

modes.name: Daily Challenge
modes.desc: Today's modifiers and a loaner loadout, the same for everyone. Reward once per day.

modes.name: Time Attack
modes.desc: Short wave timers: clear the campaign as fast as you can

modes.name: Challenge
modes.desc: Pick your own modifiers for bigger rewards

modes.name: Skirmish
modes.desc: A short match: the first 10 waves and the first boss. Half rewards.

modes.name: Mutation
modes.desc: Every wave from the second mutates: swift, armoured, bloated or swarming. Check the banner and adapt.

mutations.name: Bloated
mutations.desc: This wave has 35% more health but is 10% slower

mutations.name: Swarming
mutations.desc: 35% more enemies, each with 10% less health

mutations.name: Frail
mutations.desc: A lucky break: 20% less health this wave

modes.name: War Chest
modes.desc: One big budget and no kill or wave cash. Only your own income buildings pay. Spend wisely.

modes.name: Last Stand
modes.desc: The keep has only 40 health: a few leaks end the match. Extra cash to prepare.

modes.name: Sandbox
modes.desc: Infinite cash, every tower, start any wave. No rewards.

modes.name: Co-op
modes.desc: 2-4 players online defend one keep together.

modifiers.name: Lean times
modifiers.desc: 30% less starting cash, 10% less kill cash
